tool.name: 阿拉伯语互动课堂
tool.description: 面向中文学习者的阿拉伯语与埃及口语沉浸式互动课堂，涵盖字母发音、连写变形、符号词汇、单词卡片记忆库、超市数字生活场景与测验。
tool.descriptionEn: An immersive Egyptian Arabic interactive learning platform for Chinese speakers, featuring phonetics, joining rules, symbol vocabulary, flashcards memory deck, real-world dialogues, and quizzes.
